newsitem.title: USA: Petroleum Securities well has strong show.
newsitem.headline: Petroleum Securities well has strong show.

text.p: Petroleum Securities Australia Ltd said its Ship Shoal 194-2 well in the Gulf of Mexico was circulating and increasing mud weight to control a strong hydrocarbon show in a sand at a depth of 13,278 feet on Thursday prior to drilling ahead.

The company's weekly drilling report to the Australian Stock Exchange said the 100 percent owned well, located 10,000 feet west of the company Ship Shoal 193 production platform, had encountered two zones with hydrocarbon shows recorded on the mud log below 13,000 feet.
The commercial significance of these shows will be evaluated by electric logging after the well reaches total debth, the company said.
It also said the Main Pass 91 A-2 well was drilling at 4,474 feet after mud logs recorded two zones with natural gas shows between 4,100 and 4,450 feet.
The company also has a 100 percent working interest in this well. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
